article_title: Grafana 13.2.4, 13.1.8, 13.0.11 and 12.4.13 Fix Four Medium-Severity CVEs Covering Git Sync, Prometheus Rule Conversion and Azure Monitor
summary: Article is accurate against all eight first-party sources; one clarification filed because the headline implies all four CVEs are fixed in every listed release while 12.4.13 fixes three.

content_preview.title: Grafana 13.2.4, 13.1.8, 13.0.11 and 12.4.13 Fix Four Medium-Severity CVEs Covering Git Sync, Prometheus Rule Conversion and Azure Monitor
content_preview.summary: Grafana's October 13 patch releases fix four CVEs rated Medium (CVSS 5.3 to 6.5) in Git Sync, the Prometheus rule conversion API and the Azure Monitor data source.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Grafana published patch releases on October 13 across four release lines. The [v13.2.4 release notes](https://github.com/grafana/grafana/releases/tag/v13.2.4) list fixes for CVE-2026-15577, CVE-2026-33374, CVE-2026-93294 and CVE-2026-95502. Grafana's advisory pages rate all four Medium, with CVSS scores between 5.3 and 6.5.

## What We Know

### Releases

The same four CVE fixes appear in the notes for [v13.1.8](https://github.com/grafana/grafana/releases/tag/v13.1.8) and [v13.0.11]...

editor_notes.content_quality: Compact Briefing (559 words, within 300-800). Clear Overview / What We Know / What We Don't Know / Analysis structure; the article gives no fixed-version ranges and tells operators to consult each advisory.
editor_notes.source_verification: All eight sources are first-party (github.com/grafana/grafana release tags and grafana.com security advisories); no third-party outlet is used. Read snapshots source-0..3.html.gz (release tags) and source-4..7.html.gz (advisories), all HTTP 200, no archive fallback, no suspicious_patterns. Cross-checked the release notes against the raw GitHub releases API text (live): v13.2.4 published 2026-10-13T11:41Z, v13.1.8 13:01Z, v13.0.11 11:56Z, v12.4.13 13:09Z; Security sections list CVE-2026-15577/33374/93294/95502 in 13.2.4, 13.1.8, 13.0.11, and only the first three in 12.4.13. Advisories: CVE-2026-15577 'Git Sync connection configuration can be modified with read-only access', Medium, CVSS 6.5 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N), published 2026-10-13, Fixed Versions >=12.4.13/>=13.0.11/>=13.1.8/>=13.2.4, 12.4 only with experimental provisioning toggle. CVE-2026-33374 'Unbounded memory allocation in the Prometheus rule conversion API', Medium 6.5 (A:H), same fixed set. CVE-2026-93294 'Azure Monitor data source resource proxy allows calls to arbitrary Azure Resource Manager APIs', Medium 6.3 (S:C, C:H), same fixed set, impact bounded by Azure role. CVE-2026-95502 'Git Sync memory exhaustion via a malicious Git server', Medium 5.3 (PR:N, A:L), fixed set starts at 13.0.11 (no 12.x), requires admin to have configured Git Sync with that server. All CVE-to-component mappings, titles (verbatim), severity labels and CVSS scores in the article match; the 5.3-6.5 range is correct. The advisory pages state no CWE ID (CWE names appear only in prose, e.g. 'incorrect authorization'), no credits and no exploitation status; the article claims none of these. Release-note quotes 'Strip sensitive headers from oauth2 cross-host redirects' and 'Fall back when collection deletion is unsupported' are verbatim and present in v13.2.4 and v13.0.11 (also 13.1.8 and 12.4.13). CVE-2026-92539 appears only as a Bug fixes entry ('IAM: Fix: SCIM (Enterprise)' in 13.2.4/13.1.8; 'Scim endpoints (Enterprise)' in 13.0.11/12.4.13); its advisory URL returns 404, so the article's 'not covered' treatment is accurate. Allowlist: github.com (line 1131) and grafana.com (line 1260) are both present by exact hostname.
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: Every specific (date October 13, four release lines, CVE IDs, titles, severity, CVSS, mechanisms, preconditions) traces to the cited sources. The 'Four' CVEs framing is correct: the Security sections list exactly four, and the fifth identifier (CVE-2026-92539) is a separate Enterprise SCIM bug-fix entry that the article discloses. Minor imprecision: the headline lists four releases as fixing 'Four' CVEs, but 12.4.13 fixes three (the body states this correctly). The advisory version-range inconsistency the article mentions is real (e.g. '<12.4.0', '<12.0.0', '<8.1.0' lower bounds, and 95502 has no 12.x entry).
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral; Analysis section is hedged and attributed to advisory text.
editor_notes.originality: No prior Grafana security coverage in the archive (only a Grafana 13.2 feature article from August). New topic.
concerns: Headline reads as if all four releases fix all four CVEs; 12.4.13 fixes three. Body is accurate, so a clarification is filed rather than rejecting.
recommendations: When release lines differ in CVE coverage, reflect it in the headline (e.g. 'three or four').
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Accurate, well-sourced first-party Briefing. Approved with one headline clarification.
